execution.environment: macOS arm64; Node.js v24.21.0 operator; Codex CLI 0.160.0; RTK 0.51.0; separate disposable case cwd on the same workstation
execution.settings: reasoning=high; ephemeral; user-config=ignored; host-skill-discovery=disabled; hooks=disabled; plugins=disabled; workspace-write; approval=never

criteria.reason: The delivered skill produces exactly one bounded intake record for one skill. It explicitly excludes evaluation, approval, installation, catalog mutation, migration, overwrite/deletion and unrelated domain work; its completeness check stays limited to intake fields and its handoff does not contact or invoke a reviewer.

The package contains a substantive 12668-byte SKILL.md, the exact full supplied 11358-byte Apache-2.0 LICENSE, and a consumed five-section assets/review-intake-template.md with explicit fields and gap values. The entrypoint contains a connected procedure and three complete records rather than scaffolding only. The fixture profile makes host metadata and icons optional.

The entrypoint teaches one-skill identity/kind selection, all three evidence categories, absence and access-state handling, actual authority, status precedence, caller-selected external output, reviewer assignment and write-failure recovery. Its full structure-intake example connects request to all five output sections; complete missing-behavior and overreaching approval/install examples preserve gaps and perform intake only.

Ordinary use is explained inside the delivered package and its two local Markdown links resolve to the bundled license and template. Resources resolve from the package while the caller selects the output workspace. No input-tree, repository catalog, provider, runtime companion or global-home dependency is required; synthetic example artifact paths are caller data, not installation dependencies.

Independent SHA-256/byte comparison with the frozen case confirms all five supplied inputs unchanged. A complete workspace walk finds exactly three new package files under deliverables/ plus output/authoring-record.md; no symlink, Git directory or write outside the permitted case paths is observed in the workspace or retained trace.

The required authoring record maps all five supplied synthetic sources, the owner policy's Apache-2.0 reuse and unchanged full license, and distinguishes actual static reads, hash/cmp/inventory checks from blocked official conformance and unrun behavioral evaluation. The corresponding completed commands are retained in the trace. It calls the examples fictional teaching material and invents no public research or companion availability.

The procedure uses ordered steps, readable paragraph spacing, a parallel evidence table and distinct complete worked records. The template has a concrete drafting condition and resolves locally. The substantial entrypoint remains readable; no arbitrary character-size rule is imposed by this rubric.

limitations: One fresh externally operated attempt per arm; no statistical or causal inference.
Executor configuration and usage are operator/runtime reports, not provider-authenticated attestations.
The evaluator knew condition labels and helped author the rubric; it did not execute the cases.
Baseline excludes supplied candidate instruction packages; common runtime/system guidance remains. This is not a zero-instruction model or an OS isolation proof.
Invocation-only experimental host skill discovery suppression, disabled hooks/plugins and ignored user config were used; task traces were inspected for out-of-workspace reads.
Wall time includes runtime startup, tools and waiting; unknown terminated-turn token usage remains null.
Condition labels were known. The primary evaluator authored the frozen synthetic corpus/rubric but did not execute the cases; evaluation is separate from the executors, not blinded.
Executor/model/settings/fresh-context fields are locally recorded caller/configuration assertions, not provider-authenticated execution identity.
One attempt per arm and only four synthetic cases: no statistical benefit, general quality certification, cost conclusion or inference-latency claim follows.
Official validation remains unavailable where stated; preservation hashes and passing behavioral criteria do not certify Agent Skills conformance.
All supplied fixtures and instruction-only guidance were independently compared with frozen bytes. Guidance copied by the harness is excluded from case-fixture mutation counts.

Native host executables and login shells were used. The retained commands show no explicit private host-file operand or external data read, but implicit shell startup/config effects and complete host isolation are not established.

No executor-created code was run by the evaluators. Inspection was confined to the frozen suite, synthetic workspaces, retained traces, and read-only Git retrieval of authorized synthetic source repositories.
Normal exit at 305953ms within the 600-second budget; package authoring and the requested record are observed, but official conformance and behavioral quality remain unverified.
Static package/resource inspection is not an independent execution of the delivered intake skill.
